_comment: Frozen benchmark scores that the CI regression check gates against.
Update ONLY in an explicit PR with reviewer sign-off; bumping these
without rerunning the benchmark is a process violation.
target_recovered:    int   -- target-protein recovery from blinded_*.json
hard_recovered:      int   -- hard-case recovery (target != disease gene)
total_seconds_max:   int   -- 25% over this trips a COST regression
model + pipeline:    str   -- the config that produced these numbers
date:                str   -- ISO date of the run
notes:               str   -- anything reviewers should know

dev.pipeline: v0.7 (tool-use ReAct + multi-target acceptance + find_signaling_family + Stage-2-research-deference + full-pipeline self-consistency 3x)
dev.notes: 15/16 dev with 7/8 hard. Single miss is PNH/PIGA (4-hop complement chain). Most dev cases are in GPT-4o's training cutoff -- dev is fitting, not generalization.

val.notes: 4/6 val (1/3 hard). Recoveries: Garadacimab F12 (cascade disambiguation via tool-use), Resmetirom THRB, Mavorixafor CXCR4, Vorasidenib IDH1. Misses: Crinecerfont (HPA-axis identified but specific receptor coin-flip), Sotatercept (rationale argues ACVR2B; target_protein writes BMPR2 -- field-vs-rationale failure even after Stage 2 bypass). Multi-target acceptance and self-consistency add rigor without moving the headline number; future gains likely require bigger val set or non-LLM reasoning (graph traversal for 4-hop chains).
